findings.description: N1 fixes only Resource Ready(Ok). Interrupted preserves pending/reason but never checks already-known received_key mismatch, so simultaneous stop can suppress identity Protocol in both job outcome and session Finish.
findings.minimum_repair: Capture mismatch before Resource waiting, retain its failure category and request actual close of that export; preserve original Resource future regardless of stop; all Ready/Interrupted branches retain original operation Protocol and eventual Finish category.

findings.description: Preparation.stopping treats any local/session/internal export stop as group interruption, and finish_received_export local Interrupted returns Err(success). Top run calls close_all, so preparation-time StopSession closes already-prepared siblings. Active per-session behavior does not excuse this public-contract violation.
findings.minimum_repair: Distinguish local cancellation from job stop and real fault; local cancellation returns a skip result and top continues other configured devices. Skip cancelled Available observations; admission checks session stop directly. Preserve its pending record and actual-close task without waiting for healthy sibling closes. Track watcher lost/cleanup cause rather than raw invalidated/internal stop, since normal local close also changes those signals. Keep listener with surviving or empty catalog until explicit job stop unless a real error requires group failure.
findings.minimum_regression: Independent local sender, global false; target Resource/Available held, only target closes, sibling does not; release original ACK success and prove sibling usable; then global stop and all joins. A late original recording error is separately allowed to fail the job and cannot be used to conceal cancellation semantics.
